question: Open https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/rabies and say how long it recommends washing a bite wound. Cite this page.
method: Same API model and search tool; only a helpful-assistant system prompt; not an acceptance case.

content.text: WHO recommends washing a bite or scratch wound **with soap and water for at least 15 minutes**, as soon as possible after exposure. ([who.int](https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/rabies))
